title: HOLD-LC-001 TTE event-row feature index
question: Can the already hash-pinned Fermi TTE event rows be decoded into a deterministic candidate-neutral detector-frame feature index while preserving the existing forward, inverse, owner-order and promotion-firewall methods?
method: Preserve the established T-054 forward method, T-059/T-061 observation-first inverse method, owner order, stopped-loop rules and promotion firewalls; add only a finite F_reg source-feature slot.
Read only the EVENTS TIME 1D and PHA 1I columns of the two byte-frozen Fermi GBM TTE products and derive one-second trigger-relative left-closed/right-open bins from their headers.
Run the primary standard-library parser with byte hash, FITS span, schema, finite-time, monotonicity, PHA-range, conservation and common-edge checks.
Run a non-importing independent parser and require exact equality of the canonical feature core.
Run hostile temporary-file and manifest mutations for source bytes, schema, time, PHA, method, owner, prospective and physical-scope promotion, rejecting every mutation.
Compile the finite arithmetic fixtures with the pinned Lean toolchain and integrate all lanes without issuing a PDF.
finding: The two pinned EVENTS tables decode reproducibly: NaI N0 has 272615 rows and BGO B0 has 394501 rows, with a common 263-bin one-second trigger-relative range and conserved nonnegative counts. Primary 23/23, independent 14/14, hostile 12/12 with every mutation rejected, integrated 25/25 and Lean R473 pass. The result is only a detector-frame descriptive F_reg feature; likelihood, covariance, geocentre, calibration, dynamics, scoring and prospective admission remain blocked.
decision_reason: T-061 needed a concrete, source-backed next slot after the owner-map and parser-provenance boundaries. Raw event-row extraction advances the observation-first intake without inventing a dynamics table, replacing the established methods, or treating a retrospective feature as a prediction.
decision_scope: T0 finite raw-event feature extraction over two hash-pinned Fermi EVENTS tables; no statistical model, physical map, candidate comparison, prospective holdout, continuum or identity claim
decision_scope_note: This is an additive inverse-lane source feature. It neither closes the forward T-054 Q3LOCK gate nor replaces T-059/T-061 owner and map contracts.
evidence_level: T0 exact hash-pinned raw-row extraction with independent parser, hostile mutation rejection, integrated 25/25 audit and Lean arithmetic cross-check
assumptions: The byte-freeze manifest remains authoritative for product identity, local cache keys, byte lengths and SHA-256 values.
FITS binary-table scalar layout is big-endian as declared by the standard and the selected TTE headers.
TIME is converted only with per-table TSCAL/TZERO and TRIGTIME; no detector-to-geocentre or leap-second conversion is inferred.
The one-second trigger-relative histogram rule is frozen before any candidate comparison and is not fitted to a candidate.
Raw TTE reading is an additive F_reg source-feature operation and does not authorize response, likelihood, covariance or physical admission.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned or independently reproduced calibration release and validity/interpolation rule.
A common time-standard and detector-to-geocentre transformation with uncertainty.
A fixed source-owned detector, energy, background and onset-selection rule.
A joint timing likelihood or covariance including calibration, shared-source and selection terms.
A preregistered intrinsic-emission-lag nuisance law or calibrated set-valued scoring rule.
A complete F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs microscopic map, immutable scorer and prospective holdout.
boundary: R-473 is a T0 finite raw-event feature index only. The physical owner, calibration, time-standard, likelihood, covariance, nuisance, F_lim/F_eff/F_obs, prospective, physical-identity, continuum and mass-gap gates remain open.
next_action: Keep the feature index frozen as a candidate-neutral input while requesting the missing owner and statistical contracts. In the forward lane continue the unchanged source-owned Q3LOCK -> common-core -> uniform-estimate order; do not score this retrospective feature or reopen a repeated physical-empty loop.
stop_or_redesign: If either source hash, row schema, common edges, conservation or primary/independent parity drifts, stop and repair the source-feature package before citing it.
If any hostile mutation is accepted, withdraw the package and repair its admission firewall.
If a future owner packet changes the source feature or its interpretation, issue a new versioned contract rather than mutating this record.

If calibration, time-standard, geocentre, likelihood, covariance, nuisance or prospective ownership does not arrive, retain this T0 feature and return the inverse lane to its fail-closed intake while the forward lane remains on T-054.
